build_dataloader_for_video_dataset: build a PyTorch DataLoader for UCF101, HMDB51, or Kinetics video datasets with MSC or crop transforms
build_model_with_pretrained_checkpoint: build a video classification model from a pretrained checkpoint wrapped with a linear-head classifier
distribute_model_to_cuda: distribute a PyTorch model to single GPU, DataParallel, or DistributedDataParallel across multiple GPUs
save_and_restore_checkpoint: save and restore model checkpoints with optimizer and scheduler state using CheckpointManager
create_batch_wrapper_for_inference: create a BatchWrapper to process large tensors in smaller batches through a model
